ai_summary: **Executive Summary**  Bajaj Auto's electric three-wheeler, WEGO, achieved significant milestones by setting a record of 394.2 km on a single charge and becoming the first to complete the 4,023 km Kashmir-to-Kanyakumari journey. These validated records highlight the WEGO's superior "Maha-range" and endurance, materially enhancing Bajaj Auto's competitive position in the EV segment and promising increased earning potential for commercial operators. This positive announcement presents no apparent red flags.
